claim: Inventory disposal form submits to nonexistent endpoint /stock-outs instead of /stock-out, causing 404 failure.
evidence: backend/src/views/pages/inventory.ejs:354 await api.post('/stock-outs', { ... }) while backend/src/server.js:112 defines app.use('/api/stock-out', stockOutRoutes)
runtimeTrigger: Clicking 'Chiqindiga tashlash' button on expired inventory items in /inventory and submitting form

claim: Profanity filter falsely censors standard Uzbek business term 'chala' (meaning incomplete/unfinished), blocking legitimate product records.
evidence: backend/src/middleware/contentModerator.js:37 /(?<![\p{L}\p{N}])(chala|dalban)(?![\p{L}\p{N}])/iu blocks common Uzbek words like 'chala mahsulot', 'chala to\'langan'
runtimeTrigger: Creating or editing a product, category, or note containing the word 'chala'

claim: updateStockIn and updateStockOut calculate NaN for newQuantity/newPrice when fields are omitted in partial updates, causing crash or database corruption.
evidence: stockIn.controller.js:317 const newQuantity = parseFloat(quantity); parseFloat(undefined) -> NaN; quantityDiff = NaN; currentStock = NaN; Prisma validation crash
runtimeTrigger: PUT /api/stock-in/:id or PUT /api/stock-out/:id without passing all numeric fields in payload

claim: Audit log stat cards filter for 'stock_in' and 'stock_out' modules while backend logs 'stock' module, causing stats to permanently display 0.
evidence: audit-logs.ejs:176 logs.filter(l => l.module === 'stock_in') while stockIn.routes.js:27 logs auditLog('stock', 'in')
runtimeTrigger: Navigating to /audit-logs and viewing Kirim and Chiqim statistics cards

claim: Global 404 handler returns HTML pages/404 for all requests including /api/* routes instead of structured JSON.
evidence: backend/src/server.js:270 app.use((req, res) => { res.status(404).render('pages/404') }) renders HTML even for fetch/AJAX API requests
runtimeTrigger: Any client request to an invalid or unmapped /api/* URL

claim: Unclamped pagination parameters page=0 or negative page produce negative skip values, triggering PrismaClientUnknownRequestError and 500 crashes.
evidence: (page - 1) * limit yields -10 when page=0. Prisma throws: AssertionError('Invalid value for skip argument: Value can only be positive, found: -10')

claim: auth.controller.js login does not set accessToken cookie and logout does not clear it, breaking cookie-fallback SSR authentication.
evidence: backend/src/middleware/auth.js:10 checks req.cookies?.accessToken, but auth.controller.js never sets or clears res.cookie('accessToken')
runtimeTrigger: Navigating to protected server routes without custom Authorization headers

claim: Inventory page status filter is not processed by backend /products, resulting in inaccurate client-side filtering on pre-sliced pages.
evidence: inventory.ejs:210 params.status = st, but product.controller.js ignores status, causing client to filter only 20 pre-sliced items
runtimeTrigger: Selecting 'Yaroqsiz' or 'Yaxshi' status filter in /inventory when matching items are located on subsequent pages
